caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted head that resembles a mask or bust, positioned on a black base. The figure features a pale human face with a dark brown mustache and subtle pinkish shading on the cheeks. The head is adorned with a vibrant yellow crown decorated with blue and red jewels and yellow flower motifs. The crown is further embellished with three large white plumes extending upward. A red band outlines the mask, running from the sides of the face below the ears and under the chin. The base of the sculpture is black and is inscribed with orange lettering that reads "LORD PERCY 1892". The background is plain and off-white, with no additional decorative elements or objects present.
title: Figurehead
